messages:
marta: Heads-up — Windward LoRA bring-up results from the 30-prompt quickpack + a strapped 75-invoice stress set. Running base(redwood/xl-7b), windward-lora-v1 (fp16), windward quantized int8/int4 (blockwise). Summary below, then proposed fixes.
jules: go ahead. short bullets please.
marta: TL;DR: int8 looks ok; int4 has tokenization drift and a recurring decimal-drop on ~8% of invoices in extended set. Also saw 2 streaming fallbacks.
dmitri: numbers?
marta: pasted metrics (aggregated):

```
model                          ExactMatch  F1   num_halluc  fmt_mismatch  mean_tok_shift
redwood/xl-7b_fp16 (base)      88%         93%  1.3%        1/300         0.000
windward-lora-v1_fp16          89%         93%  1.0%        1/300         0.001
windward-lora-v1_int8          88%         92%  1.6%        4/300         0.005
windward-lora-v1_int4          82%         88%  7.9%       24/300         0.026
```

notes: fmt_mismatch counts canonical currency formatting diffs. num_halluc flags where numeric tokens were invented or dropped.

priya: examples?
marta: example: prompt expects "$2,345.70". int4 outputs "two thousand three hundred forty five" (missing .70) or returns "2345.7" (loses trailing zero). Another: "INV:123-45-6" tokenization split on hyphens under int4 -> downstream parser fails.
dmitri: did you compare token embedding deltas for special tokens? hyphens, colon, comma, $ etc?
marta: yes. observed mean embedding L2 delta across special invoice tokens = 0.028 for int4 vs 0.003 for int8. Top deltas: "$" -> 0.045, "," -> 0.032, "INV:" -> 0.037.
jules: pipeline used? merge-before-quant or apply-on-quant?
marta: merge->clip->quant (merge LoRA into fp16 checkpoint then quantize). Commands: 
```
commit: c3f4e8b
merge: ./bin/merge_lora --base redwood/xl-7b --lora windward-lora-v1 --out /tmp/windward-merged
clip: python scripts/clip_weights.py /tmp/windward-merged --epsilon 1e-5
quant: ./bin/quantize --model /tmp/windward-merged --bits 4 --group_size 128 --calib 2048 --method blockwise
```

priya: history: we saw similar decimal-drop on a different customer when group_size was large. Might be local scale mismatch.
dmitri: two-pronged plan: 1) try base-quant-first then apply LoRA (graft-on-quant), 2) build a tiny per-token logit bias map for numeric/currency tokens to correct formatting during decode.
jules: add 3) try group_size=64 with larger calib (4096) as a variant.
priya: I can prototype the bias map. Approach: compute top-K token pairs where embedding delta > threshold, estimate a per-token additive to logits during beam/greedy decode (small magnitude, e.g. +-0.1 to 0.5), run ablation. Script: `tools/patch_logit_bias.py --model quant4 --tokens tokens.json --deltas deltas.csv --out patched/`.
marta: I'll run three quant variants overnight: A) graft-on-quant (quant base then apply LoRA), B) merge-then-quant with group=64/calib=4096, C) merge-then-quant + priya bias map. Will post results in morning.
qa-bot: queued expanded quickpack for each variant. Blocking thresholds: num_halluc > 3.5% or fmt_mismatch > 10/300. Current int4 baseline = 24/300 -> blocks.
infra-bot: logs: two streaming fallbacks observed on kernel `quant4-stream-v1` (trace ids: s-901, s-902), both occurred during first-chunk decode. Filing INF ticket INF-4080.
dmitri: reproduction steps for anyone: 
```
# reproduce
git checkout c3f4e8b
./bin/merge_lora --base redwood/xl-7b --lora windward-lora-v1 --out /tmp/windward-merged
./bin/quantize --model /tmp/windward-merged --bits 4 --group_size 128 --calib 2048 --method blockwise
python tools/run_quickpack.py --model /tmp/windward-merged.quant4 --prompts evals/windward-invoices-30.json --out quickruns/1745812345
```

jules: outstanding owners: priya -> bias prototype (ETA EOD), marta -> runs A/B/C overnight, dmitri -> add 75 stress prompts (edge decimals, negative amounts, hyphenated IDs) by EOD. I’ll hold canary promotion until green.
deploy-bot: noted. Promotion for `windward-lora-v1_int4` blocked until explicit release.
priya: quick note — bias map can over-correct; will include small validation set to ensure no new hallucinations introduced.
marta: perfect. reconvene in AM. thanks team. :coffee:
